cards.q: Sections of a suspected ADR reporting form (PvPI)
cards.a: Patient; reaction; suspected drugs with dechallenge and rechallenge; concomitant drugs; reporter details

cards.q: What a trial consent form must explain
cards.a: Purpose, treatments and randomisation, procedures, risks, benefits, alternatives, injury compensation, payments

cards.q: Signature section of a trial consent form
cards.a: Study title; subject initials and identifiers; initialled statements; subject or representative signature; investigator and witness signatures

cards.q: Mistakes to spot in a trial consent or document
cards.a: Non-local or jargon language; no voluntariness or withdrawal statement; missing risks, alternatives, compensation; coercion; no ethics approval

cards.q: Dosage-form or device station: what to cover
cards.a: Form or device name, route, typical drug and class, advantage, correct use, precautions and adverse effects

cards.q: Child dose for 20 kg when adult dose is 500 mg (weight-based)
cards.a: About 143 mg (weight ratio 20/70 x 500 mg; arithmetic)

cards.q: Sections of a package insert
cards.a: Names, composition, clinical pharmacology, indications, dosage, contraindications, warnings, adverse effects, interactions, overdose, storage, manufacturer

cards.q: Elements on a dispensed-medicine label
cards.a: Generic and brand name, dosage strength, total volume, lot and expiry date, NDC, manufacturer, mixing directions, label alerts

cards.q: Core questions for a first look at a paper (Sarkar)
cards.a: Aim important? Outcome matters clinically? Design sound? Primary outcome assessed properly? Sample large enough? Reason to doubt validity?

cards.q: Faults typically planted in an ethics-dilemma trial scenario
cards.a: No ethics approval; missing, coerced or non-local consent; unjustified vulnerable groups; placebo despite proven treatment; no injury plan; undeclared conflict; confidentiality breach

cards.q: Properties every OSPE station must be shown to have
cards.a: Validity and reliability; each station about 5 minutes
